issue: LINE login showed an unbound-account message after release
rootCause: The web bundles were built with relative /api/v1 while their static Nginx hosts do not proxy /api/v1. LINE exchange POST reached the static member host and returned HTTP 405.
fix: Build member and admin with https://api.ucell.life/api/v1; preserve LINE, Google and Entra client settings. Report infrastructure failures without claiming an account is unbound.
prevention: deployment/build-production-web.ps1 sets and verifies the production API endpoint.

tests.liveCrossOriginPreflight: PASS for member and admin origins
tests.invalidDiagnosticLineToken: API returns JSON LINE_TOKEN_INVALID / 401 with expected CORS origin
tests.personalLineLogin: Not impersonated or tested with user credentials
